items.summary: Recommendation: retain containment-only execution and reject all new production admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 54 improvements awaiting measurement, 21 failed requests, 7 repair follow-ups, and 108 approved proposals without execution. Financial claims remain unsupported: Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21, showing 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; named site rows show $0 attributable commission. September AI usage is $995.6520482 across 5,504 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors, but no infrastructure, domain, labor, hosting, or marketing ledger is supplied. Do not claim revenue, contribution margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecast attainment, or causal lift.

The latest authoritative snapshot reports September AI cost of $995.6520482 and 5,504 calls, while an earlier CFO handoff reported $988.9074759 and 5,470 calls. Treat the latest snapshot as current but preserve the discrepancy for reconciliation; do not publish either figure as a final accounting total until the source extract is reconciled. The minimum measurement for contribution margin is a dated cost ledger aligned to the same period and site identifiers, including AI, infrastructure, hosting, domains, labor, and marketing, matched to attributable revenue.

Do not admit the allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement on financial grounds until existing attribution boundaries are preserved and the measurement window is recorded. Its 2026-09-21 baseline is 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission; any post-change clicks are an operating metric, not proof of revenue or ROI unless matched to attributable commission and period-aligned costs. No spend, billing, credentials, banking access, contracts, or infrastructure changes are authorized.
